THO.Settings.Enabled.Name: Tactical Hex Occupancy
THO.Settings.Enabled.Hint: On hexagonal or square-grid scenes, show a marker when two or more visible tokens occupy the same grid space, including multi-space tokens.
THO.HexOccupancy.Ended: These tokens no longer share this occupied grid space.
THO.HexOccupancy.Control: Control token (Shift preserves the current selection)
THO.HexOccupancy.SheetDenied: You cannot open this actor sheet.
THO.HexOccupancy.GumConflict: GURPS GUM has its own native implementation of this feature. Because this world uses the GUM system, Tactical Hex Occupancy will remain inactive to prevent duplication.
